description: Read a session: whether it is open, expired or closed, its maximum, what it has drawn and what remains, and its draws, newest first, each drawn, unknown or returned. Use it to resume a run, or to find a draw to settle. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_spend_session
